$comment: Moderators (rows 30, 58, 71) are NEVER scored. Each rule below adjusts INTERPRETATION and is OFF by default (enabled=false). A 'weight_multiplier' rule multiplies the effective weight of target variables on one axis when the moderator observation carries the given label; the factor is a number that GG must choose, so it ships as TO_CALIBRATE and an enabled rule with an uncalibrated factor fails loudly. A 'note' rule only adds an interpretation note to the score output (no number changes). Rule ids are stamped on the output when applied.

rules.rationale: Row 30 says product type changes which cost variables matter (for a physical good, material and energy cost lines carry more information than for a service). The set of target variables is the assistant's reading of that sentence; the factor is deliberately uncalibrated.

Row 58: family ownership changes how management turnover should be read (turnover in a family firm is more often a succession than a search for direction). Always read jointly with new_generation_management, never scored on its own.

effect.text: Recent M&A (past 2 years): cuts both ways (growth appetite vs. integration distraction). Not scored; clarify at first contact.

rules.rationale: Row 71 says: flag rather than score until clarified at first contact. A note-only rule changes no number, so it is on by default.
